name: Runemaster audit #2736: Ley Constitution raises item-derived armor by 30%
contract: Ley Constitution 705562: 'Your Armor contribution from items is increased by 30%.' Re-verified in Spell.dbc:
Effect0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_BASE_RESISTANCE_PCT (142), MiscValue 1 (physical/armor school bit, no per-
subclass ItemArmorSubclassMask), EffectBasePoints0 29 with DieSides 1 = +30%. Re-verified against the engine
GetItemArmorSubclassMask() first (0 here, so it skips the narrower per-subclass branch) and instead calls
target->ApplyStatPctModifier(UNIT_MOD_ARMOR, BASE_PCT, amount) for the physical school bit. Player::UpdateArmor
(StatSystem.cpp:364-390) computes value = GetFlatModifierValue(UNIT_MOD_ARMOR, BASE_VALUE) (base armor from
items), then value *= GetPctModifierValue(UNIT_MOD_ARMOR, BASE_PCT) - exactly the slot this aura writes -
and only afterwards adds GetStat(STAT_AGILITY) * 2.0f (armor from stats). This is a stock native aura path
with no CoA-specific gap; zero occurrences of 705562 in src/server/coa/. Expected: with the talent, total
armor rises (scaling only the item-derived portion, so by less than a flat 30% of the total); unlearning

steps.label: SETUP: character has some item armor
CONTRACT: total armor rises (item portion scales by 30%)
